title: Background Services
description: Schedule, monitor and control every recurring or background job across all workspaces.
read_only_banner: Read-only — only the main administrator can run or configure background services.

grace_days.label: Grace period (days)
grace_days.help: Wait this many days past the due date before flipping the status. 0 = flip immediately.

grace_hours.label: Grace period (hours)
grace_hours.help: Wait this many hours past the scheduled time before marking as missed.

days_resolved.label: Resolved for (days)
days_resolved.help: Auto-close a resolved ticket that stays resolved for this many days without activity.

age_days.label: Age (days)
age_days.help: Delete rows older than this many days. Older = more history kept.

retention_days.label: Log retention (days)
retention_days.help: Delete SystemLogs older than this many days.

run_retention_days.label: Run history retention (days)
run_retention_days.help: Delete process-run history older than this many days. Floored at 30 to preserve the audit trail.

fallback_retention_days.label: Fallback retention (days)
fallback_retention_days.help: Used when an endpoint has no per-endpoint LogRetentionDays set.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.help: Maximum number of emails processed per run.

confirm.run_desc: "{{name}}" will start immediately outside its normal schedule.
confirm.stop_desc: "{{name}}" is currently running. Stopping mid-run may leave partial work behind.

actions.run_now_locked: Only the main administrator can run processes
actions.pause_locked: Only the main administrator can pause processes
actions.locked_tooltip: Only the main administrator can perform this action

stop_tooltip: Stop is advisory — pause the schedule to prevent further runs
no_schedule_hint: This process has no schedule row yet — enable it once from the drawer header to persist.
diagnostics_intro: Automated checks answering why is this process blocked?

access_banner.body: You don’t have permission to view processes. The list below is unavailable until an administrator grants access — no cached or sample data is being shown.

toast.read_only_desc: Only the main administrator can run, pause, or configure processes.

admin.purge-system-logs.name: Purge system logs
admin.purge-system-logs.description: Delete SystemLogs rows older than the retention window.

admin.retry-failed-emails.name: Retry failed outbound emails
admin.retry-failed-emails.description: Re-send OutboundEmailLog rows still in status=failed with attempts < max_attempts. Every send attempt (success or failure) is logged with its provider error for audit.

admin.invoices-mark-overdue.name: Mark overdue invoices
admin.invoices-mark-overdue.description: Flip invoices past their DueDate to status=overdue when they still have an unpaid balance. Skips drafts, cancelled, and fully-paid invoices.

admin.offers-mark-expired.name: Expire past-due offers
admin.offers-mark-expired.description: Move draft/sent/pending offers past ValidUntil into status=expired so pipeline views stay accurate.

admin.dispatches-mark-missed.name: Mark missed dispatches
admin.dispatches-mark-missed.description: Mark scheduled dispatches that never started (no ActualStartTime) more than a grace window past their ScheduledDate as status=missed.

admin.payment-installments-mark-overdue.name: Mark overdue payment installments
admin.payment-installments-mark-overdue.description: Flip pending PaymentPlanInstallments past their DueDate to status=overdue.

admin.support-tickets-autoclose-resolved.name: Auto-close resolved support tickets
admin.support-tickets-autoclose-resolved.description: Close tickets that have been in status=resolved for longer than the configured window.

admin.draft-offers-purge.name: Purge abandoned draft offers
admin.draft-offers-purge.description: Hard-delete offers stuck in status=draft that haven’t been touched for the age window.

admin.draft-invoices-purge.name: Purge abandoned draft invoices
admin.draft-invoices-purge.description: Hard-delete invoices stuck in status=draft that haven’t been touched for the age window.

admin.notifications-purge-read.name: Purge read notifications
admin.notifications-purge-read.description: Delete Notification rows where IsRead=true and CreatedAt older than the retention window.

admin.notifications-purge-stale-unread.name: Purge stale unread notifications
admin.notifications-purge-stale-unread.description: Delete very old unread notifications so the tray doesn’t accumulate abandoned rows.

admin.calendar-events-purge-past.name: Purge past calendar events
admin.calendar-events-purge-past.description: Delete completed/cancelled calendar events whose End is older than the retention window.

admin.sync-changes-purge.name: Purge old sync changes
admin.sync-changes-purge.description: Trim the SyncChanges outbox so offline-sync bookkeeping doesn’t grow forever.

admin.sync-receipts-purge.name: Purge old sync receipts
admin.sync-receipts-purge.description: Delete SyncOperationReceipt rows older than the retention window.

admin.webhook-jobs-purge.name: Purge completed webhook jobs
admin.webhook-jobs-purge.description: Delete WebhookForwardJobs that finished (completed or dead_letter) longer ago than the retention window.

admin.external-endpoint-logs-purge.name: Purge external endpoint logs
admin.external-endpoint-logs-purge.description: Per-endpoint retention: uses each ExternalEndpoint’s own LogRetentionDays to trim its ExternalEndpointLogs.

admin.dispatch-audit-purge.name: Purge old dispatch audit logs
admin.dispatch-audit-purge.description: Delete DispatchAuditLogs older than the retention window.

admin.hr-audit-purge.name: Purge old HR audit logs
admin.hr-audit-purge.description: Delete HrAuditLogs older than the retention window.

admin.soft-deleted-purge.name: Hard-purge soft-deleted records
admin.soft-deleted-purge.description: Permanently delete rows across invoices, offers, deals, sales, articles, dispatches, and service orders that were soft-deleted longer than the retention window ago.

admin.recurring-task-logs-purge.name: Purge old recurring task logs
admin.recurring-task-logs-purge.description: Delete RecurringTaskLog rows older than the retention window.

admin.purge-system-logs.whenItRuns: Once every 24 hours — after the midnight housekeeping window.

admin.retry-failed-emails.whenItRuns: Every 5 minutes — keeps the outbound queue moving.
inputs: OutboundEmailLog rows with Status=failed, Attempts<MaxAttempts, NextRetryAt≤now
Original send payload (recipients, subject, body, attachments)
outputs: Updates Status → sent / failed with exponential NextRetryAt
Transitions orphaned rows (missing account/user) to gave_up

admin.invoices-mark-overdue.whenItRuns: Every hour — keeps AR aging accurate.

inputs: Offers where ValidUntil<now and Status in (sent, pending)
Drafts are excluded — an unsent offer cannot expire
Dispatches with ScheduledDate<now−grace_hours and no ActualStartTime
SupportTickets with Status=resolved and last activity older than days_resolved
Offers with Status=draft older than age_days
outputs: Reports 'skipped' with block_reason if child FK constraints prevent deletion (retrying can't fix it)

inputs: Invoices with Status=draft older than age_days
outputs: Reports 'skipped' with block_reason on FK constraint

inputs: Notifications with IsRead=true older than age_days
Notifications with IsRead=false older than age_days
CalendarEvents whose End<now−age_days and Status in (completed, cancelled)
SyncChanges rows with ChangedAt older than age_days
SyncOperationReceipts with CreatedAt older than age_days
WebhookForwardJobs with Status in (completed, dead_letter) and CompletedAt older than age_days
ExternalEndpointLogs older than each endpoint's retention
outputs: Hard-deletes matching logs endpoint by endpoint

inputs: Rows with IsDeleted=true and DeletedAt older than age_days across: invoices, offers, deals, sales, articles, dispatches, service_orders
outputs: Hard-deletes matching rows per table (independent — one table's FK block never fails the whole run)
Reports per-table counts and a skipped_tables list

inputs: RecurringTaskLogs with GeneratedDate older than age_days

errors.check_violation_hint_named: A row violated the "{{name}}" rule. The allowed values or ranges for that column don't include what the process tried to write.
errors.check_violation_hint: A row violated a database check rule.
errors.unique_violation_hint: The process tried to insert a value that already exists in a unique column.
errors.fk_violation_hint: A foreign key points to a row that no longer exists.
errors.not_null_hint: A column that cannot be NULL was left empty.
errors.undef_table_hint: A migration may not have run. Restart the backend or check the schema.
errors.undef_column_hint: The code references a column that doesn't exist. A migration is likely out of sync.
errors.serialization_hint: Two transactions touched the same rows. This usually retries automatically.
errors.canceled_hint: The database statement was aborted, likely due to a timeout.
errors.conn_lost_hint: The connection to Postgres dropped mid-query.
errors.no_handler_hint: The scheduler picked this process up but no handler is wired for its key.
errors.op_canceled_hint: The run was stopped — by an operator, a timeout, or a shutdown.
errors.http_429_hint: Rate limited by the downstream service.
errors.http_5xx_hint: Downstream service returned a server error.

block_details.retries_exhausted: Retries exhausted — auto-run paused. Use “Reset failures” to re-arm.

category_hint.missing_handler: The server has no code registered for this process key. Redeploy the backend or check Program.cs registrations.
category_hint.missing_schedule: No schedule row exists yet — the process has never been persisted. Run it once or save an interval to create it.
category_hint.missing_dependency: A table, column, account or external service the process needs is not available. Check the last error text for details.
category_hint.permission_denied: The database or API user is missing rights for a table this process touches. Grant SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and retry.
category_hint.database_error: PostgreSQL rejected the query (constraint, deadlock, invalid schema). Inspect the raw error before retrying.
category_hint.timeout: The handler exceeded its runtime budget. Consider raising the interval or narrowing the workload.
category_hint.retries_exhausted: The retry ladder is used up. Reset failures once the underlying cause is fixed.
category_hint.scheduler_overdue: The schedule row is healthy but the scheduler has not picked it up since its due time. Check that the background hosted service is running, that the process tick loop hasn't crashed, and that no earlier long-running job is blocking the tick.
category_hint.runtime_error: The handler threw an unexpected error. Inspect the raw error text and backend logs.

health.no_issues: No blocked or failing services. {{paused}} paused · {{total}} total.
health.all_running: {{active}} background services are scheduled and running. {{paused}} paused · {{total}} total.

stale_banner: Showing the last known state — the server didn't respond to the latest refresh.
history_empty: No runs recorded yet. Use “Run now” to execute this process.

live.stale_warning: The server keeps returning the same data while this process is reported as running. The view may be cached — use Hard refresh to force live data.

reason.not_registered: Not registered on the server — this job is not scheduled and will never run.
reason.overdue: Overdue — the scheduler has not executed this job since it was due at {{due}}.
reason.disabled: Disabled — switched off by an administrator.
